## Names

<a id="set_irq_timer"></a>
### [`set_irq_timer`](../../../../src/init/screen.asm#L6) `$0A31`

*routine*

Sets the latch of CIA 1 timer A to $4289 cycles, the rate of the timer interrupt.

- **Called from:** [`cold_start`](entry.md#cold_start) [`$091C`](../../../../src/init/entry.asm#L25)
- **Writes:** [`CIATAHI`](../../memory-map.md#CIATAHI), [`CIATALO`](../../memory-map.md#CIATALO)

<a id="screen_off"></a>
### [`screen_off`](../../../../src/init/screen.asm#L13) `$0A3C`

*routine*

Turns the screen off: $d011 = $0b (display off, 25 rows, Y scroll 3).

- **Called from:** [`menu`](../menu/menu.md#menu) [`$0BC1`](../../../../src/menu/menu.asm#L104), [`swap_pictures`](../tools/swap.md#swap_pictures) [`$3696`](../../../../src/tools/swap.asm#L7)
- **Writes:** [`SCROLY`](../../memory-map.md#SCROLY)

<a id="screen_on"></a>
### [`screen_on`](../../../../src/init/screen.asm#L18) `$0A42`

*routine*

Turns the screen on: sets bit 4 of $d011.

- **Called from:** [`start_main`](start.md#start_main) [`$0A91`](../../../../src/init/start.asm#L22), [`cmd_storage`](../menu/menu.md#cmd_storage) [`$0C30`](../../../../src/menu/menu.asm#L164), [`start_tool`](../tools/tool_start.md#start_tool) [`$0DD3`](../../../../src/tools/tool_start.asm#L8), [`tool_oops`](../tools/mirror_oops_tool.md#tool_oops) [`$1668`](../../../../src/tools/mirror_oops_tool.asm#L43)
- **Jumped to from:** [`bitmap_mode_on`](../graphics/display_mode.md#bitmap_mode_on) [`$1507`](../../../../src/graphics/display_mode.asm#L16), [`text_mode_on`](../graphics/display_mode.md#text_mode_on) [`$1522`](../../../../src/graphics/display_mode.asm#L28), [`swap_pictures`](../tools/swap.md#swap_pictures) [`$36A5`](../../../../src/tools/swap.asm#L13)
- **Reads:** [`SCROLY`](../../memory-map.md#SCROLY)
- **Writes:** [`SCROLY`](../../memory-map.md#SCROLY)

<a id="init_menu_screen"></a>
### [`init_menu_screen`](../../../../src/init/screen.asm#L24) `$0A4B`

*routine*

Prepares the menu text screen: cursor_colour_timer = 2, $d018 = $17, clears the button state, then $1c2f (black border, screen off, the script at $1ef8 with the character ROM visible, $d018 = $74 and VIC bank 1: screen $5c00, charset $5000).

- **Called from:** [`start_main`](start.md#start_main) [`$0A7F`](../../../../src/init/start.asm#L14)
- **Jumps to:** [`build_menu_charset`](menu_charset.md#build_menu_charset)
- **Writes:** [`cursor_colour_timer`](../../memory-map.md#cursor_colour_timer), [`VMCSB`](../../memory-map.md#VMCSB), [`button_press_edge`](../../memory-map.md#button_press_edge), [`button_held`](../../memory-map.md#button_held)
